name: Missouri River (Craig)
blurb: Tailwater giant. Steady dam-controlled flows, trout everywhere, drift boats everywhere too.

sections.notes: Launch below Holter Dam and finish at Craig FAS. Arrange your shuttle before launching; ramps can be busy.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate river mileage from the difference between nearby FWP 0.1-mile markers on the same river. Facility locations and mapped channels introduce uncertainty; this is not a surveyed paddling route or a speed calibration.

putInAccess.note: BLM confirms the campground and boat ramp, but its published coordinate is a facility location. Exact landing position has not been independently confirmed.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Holter Dam Campground boat ramp below the dam. This marker identifies the campground; it does not pinpoint the ramp edge.
